dedupe_keys.name: health indicator hospital ambulatory care case costs cacs 2014 version

description: Five metadata records describe hospital case costs using ambulatory ACCS/CACS and inpatient CMG/Plex or CMG+ groupings. Listed historical periods include 2006–2010 for ACCS, 2006–2007 for CMG/Plex, and 2006–2013 for CMG+ 2013; a later inpatient package starts in 2009. The 2014 labels identify grouper versions, not proven data coverage. Every package links an IHDA indicator interface; downloadable encoding and cost fields are unstated. This bounded family preserves different service/grouper definitions and does not treat them as numerically interchangeable. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
